title: Technical content writer
description:
**Technical content writer**

Experience: **2-3 years**

**Required Skills**

* Impeccable written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Understand technology and turn complex technical concepts into high-quality & plagiarism-free content that is technically accurate by adhering to deadlines.
* Work closely with UI/UX developers and participate in design meetings.
* Ensure compliance with documentation styles and standards.
* Ability to capture information by performing web research.
* Understand technical writing principles like single sourcing, minimalism, and topic-based writing.

**Good to have**

* Experience with BA tools that include Balsamiq cloud, MS Visio.
* Knowledge of SDLC & DDLC
* Basic designing skills in Figma or XD
* Ability to develop wireframes/prototypes using wireframing tools.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Kochi, Kerala
